title: Remove the “Built with … caffeine.ai” footer attribution

requirements.text: In the public site footer (frontend/src/components/app/PublicFooter.tsx), remove the “Built with” text span, the heart icon SVG, the “using” text span, and the caffeine.ai external link so they no longer render in the footer. Keep the rest of the footer unchanged (including the disclaimer block and the surrounding layout/styling).
acceptanceCriteria: The footer no longer shows the text “Built with”.
The heart icon no longer appears in the footer.
The footer no longer shows the text “using”.
The “caffeine.ai” link is removed and no longer appears in the DOM.
The disclaimer section remains present and unchanged.

constraints: Apply the change only to the selected footer elements (Built with / heart icon / using / caffeine.ai link) and do not alter other footer content.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Changing the disclaimer text or styling.
Adding a replacement attribution/link or any new footer content.
